biggest_catch: Cohley is a brand-facing enterprise platform: there is no public creator pay rate card — the $250/asset figure is guidance for BRANDS on what to budget, and the catalog's $200 claim is unsupported. Actual pay is whatever the brand sets in the creative brief.
catches: The 'Typically pricing begins at $250 per asset' figure is brand-facing budget guidance, not a creator pay guarantee — actual compensation is set per creative brief by the client and can also be free product only.
Creators are paid by the CLIENT, not by Cohley: 'Creator shall be paid by Client in accordance with the Creative Brief' — Cohley explicitly disclaims liability if a client fails to pay.
Payment arrives no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date — slow compared to other platforms.
The creator bears all PayPal fees (2.9% of total compensation) plus taxes; fail to set up PayPal within 30 days of campaign end and you forfeit all compensation.
Pre-vetted creator network: you need an existing portfolio and to pass vetting — not open to beginners.
Content ownership/license terms are in the brand's favor per the creator terms (review the Ownership section before signing).

steps: Create your free Cohley creator account and complete your profile with a name, email, country of residence, profile photo, and portfolio work samples (portfolio is required — vetting is not automatic).
Review and accept Cohley's Creator Terms & Conditions — note you are paid by the client, not Cohley, and you bear PayPal fees.
Get matched to brand briefs (AI-matched by niche and demographics); each brief states its compensation — confirm it is cash, not product-only, before accepting.
Deliver the assets per the brief (typical 21-34 second 9:16 video, ~1 week turnaround).
Set up your PayPal account within 30 days of the campaign end date or you forfeit compensation.
Receive payment per the creative brief, no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date, minus 2.9% PayPal fees.
timing: Paid by the client per the creative brief, no earlier than 30 days after the campaign end date.
